newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt Q3 March 31 net up after gain.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt Q3 March 31 net up after gain.

text.p: Mallinckrodt Inc on Friday said its operating earnings in the fiscal third quarter rose in spite of pricing pressure and net income was affected by a one-time gain from a sale of one of its businesses.
The company said operating income in the three months ended March 31 rose to $53.6 million from $45.6 million in the year-earlier quarter.
Net income totaled $323.8 million, or $4.31 a share, including a gain from the sale of the Tastemaker unit, versus $48.3 million, or $0.64, last year.
The Tastemaker sale contributed $270.6 million, or $3.60 a share, to the latest earnings results, Mallinckrodt said.
Overall sales rose to $578.1 million from $572.6 million, the company said.
Mallinckrodt is a health-care products and a specialty chemical manufacturing company.
Its shares were off 1-7/8 at 37-5/8 early Friday afternoon.
